contents.reason: This run's B19 item thm-vanishing-viscosity-convergence-for-hamilton-jacobi-equations proves qualitative locally uniform convergence under a bounded, locally equicontinuous family of viscous solutions and supplies no error rate. Quantitative rates and nonlinear-adjoint estimates are outside this selected run, with no current destination assigned.
